race.comment: MY TESTIMONY (5) lands here as the one to beat on resumption following some solid efforts in defeat to end last campaign. Her latest trial suggests she's not gone backwards in the break and she's still open to plenty of improvement. Will need some luck from the draw, but she finds a winnable race and can return on a winning note. INCREDIBLE MR FOX (7) will find this easier than what he's been racing in, dropping back from the midweeks to this race. Pike's booking is a big push for his chances and with the visors going on, he can make a statement. FLASH OF FINA (9) has impressed in both trials this time in and the inside draw is a big push for his chances. Should get every chance with no weight on his back to fire on debut. MISS PROFLIGACY (11) is another debutant with a genuine chance after a close Belmont trial second. Has shown enough to suggest she has some ability. CACHACA (2) can improve coming in trip and with the fresh run out of the way.
